title: 14 Fennick: bill approvals hero
strengths: The proof is the product's own feature set as an accountant would set it: the drawer's 'If you approve' ledger as a footed column ($63,904.52 − 15,277.75 − 7,418.60 = $41,208.17), tabular figures, $ only on the first line and the total, a single rule over the total and a double rule under it on the figures only

Exact alignment between claim, proof and picture: the ledger's left edge stands on the drawer's content edge in the screen below (966 px), its double rule ends level with the button, and the 1344 px window sits on the 48 px margins

Restraint: one regular-weight two-line headline in the buyer's words, one green action (the product's Approve green), no kicker, pill, glow or invented proof; the real bills screen flat and whole, cropped where the list ends on a row boundary and the drawer's sticky footer starts under its own 'If you approve' heading
slop_signals: At thumbnail size it is a sibling of heroes/11 (Purlin): a white finance page, a two-line headline on the left, a block on the right, the product below
The Fennick frond appears twice: in the nav and, inside the product, as the customer's workspace icon (product-side)
fixes: Product-side: give Bramblecote Foods its own workspace icon in product/02, and set data-theme="light" on its <html> so an OS dark preference doesn't flip the embedded screen
If the owner wants more distance from heroes/11: make the ledger carry the page (larger figures over the drawer column) or set the product on a pale stage band
